decision_rules.text: ADMITTED iff the primary official SLU CI95 lower bound is > 0 against cell B7a, intent is non-inferior at the own null margin 1.0051 pp, the symmetric-normalised scorer agrees in sign (or, if no TRAIN sibling is registered at read time, projection v3 agrees in sign and the substitution is recorded), and no scenario loses intent beyond the null band. NEUTRAL iff both primary metrics are non-inferior within the own null margins (SLU 1.1218, intent 1.0051). A NEUTRAL B7r or B7c enters the SLURP default plan ONLY if it lowers cost: B7c does, because it removes a measured 6,648,366 characters of duplicated task contract from the run's wire text at no measured quality cost; B7r does not, because a constrained Reviewer output contract lowers no cost. HARMFUL otherwise, and then that cell's successors do not fly.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. Do not automatically restart, replay, filter rows, change the roster, role graph, prompts, geometry or caps. At most one root-diagnosed recovery may be separately registered; a second failure closes that flight and the fix must be proven on a four-row dry run before another mechanism. One experiment in flight at a time.
